Chapter 371 - 371 Receiving the Award! (1)

371 Receiving the Award! (1)

Manager Zhang’s name was Zhang Wenbo.

A few months ago, he was just an ordinary salesman in Xiao Wu Wholesale City. He was constantly hesitating whether to leave or not.

One day, a business manager named Xiong Jianping accidentally saw a client contract.

Hence, Xiong Jianping took the initiative to ask for the contract.

After that… Zhang Wenbo got to know that the client and Xiong Jianping had a grudge against each other.

Therefore, when the customer arrived at Xiao Wu Wholesale City, Xiong Jianping deliberately made things difficult for the other party.

It was because of this that Xiong Jianping and the leaders who supported him were severely punished.

The reason why such a thing happened was because there was a young man standing beside the customer… It was Lin Fan!

Zhang Wenbo clearly remembered how respectful the chairman, director, general manager, and other company executives were to Lin Fan.

The company dealt with the relevant personnel in a thunderous manner after the incident.

It was also because of this that there were many vacancies in Xiao Wu Wholesale City, which gave Zhang Wenbo the opportunity to become a business manager.

If Xiao Wu Wholesale City were just an ordinary wholesale company like before, it would not be anything to shout about. A business manager was nothing.

However, Xiao Wu Wholesale City later established a deep partnership with Flower Stem.

The income and power of all the employees had also increased substantially.

One had to know…

Nowadays, the perfume and beauty essence of Flower Stem were the hottest in Hua Nation, especially in Jiang Province.

By chance, Zhang Wenbo learned that the reason why Xiao Wu Wholesale City was able to establish a close connection with Flower Stem was all because of Lin Fan.

Because of this, Lin Fan became even more majestic in Zhang Wenbo’s heart.

That was why he was so respectful when he saw Lin Fan.

…

All the previous times Lin Fan went to Xiao Wu Wholesale Market, Zhang Wenbo had only looked at him from afar.

Lin Fan did not even see Zhang Wenbo.

Therefore, even though Lin Fan had a photographic memory, he did not know Zhang Wenbo at all.

“And you are?” he asked.

“I’m Zhang Wenbo, the business manager of Xiao Wu Wholesale Market,” Zhang Wenbo quickly introduced himself.

When Lin Fan heard this, he had a look of realization.

Wang Xiu, who was standing at the side, could not help but ask, “M-Manager Zhang, do you know each other?”

When he said this, Wang Xiu had a bad premonition.

The business manager of Xiao Wu Wholesale City did have some power in the past.

However, Zhang Wenbo was on another level now.

The reason for this was that Xiao Wu Wholesale City had established a close partnership with Flower Stem and had a large number of Flower Stem’s perfumes and essence.

There was no need to worry about sales.

It could be said that as long as one could get their hands on Flower Stem’s perfumes and essence, it would mean a huge profit.

In such a situation, how could the business manager not be fought over?

It was also for this reason that when Wang Xiu asked Zhang Wenbo out for dinner, she was so sure that she would earn money.

In the past, when Zhang Wenbo faced Wang Xiu, he always put on airs.

After all, that was because she wanted to get a good contract from him.

At this moment, Zhang Wenbo bowed slightly and said, “Madam Wang, I’m sorry. I didn’t know that you knew Mr. Lin. I’ve offended you…”

Lin Fan said, “No need to apologize. I don’t know this Madam Wang. I’m good friends with her nephew, Ma Zhong.

“A few days ago, Ma Zhong’s father was misdiagnosed with late-stage lung cancer. Mrs. Wang was afraid that Ma Zhong’s family would find it difficult to repay her the 100,000 yuan they owed.

“So, she went straight to Ma Zhong’s father’s house and asked him not to waste money on treatment and to repay her 100,000 yuan.

“I helped them repay the money.

“At the same time, my good friend, Ma Zhong, has also completely severed all ties with her.”

Lin Fan’s tone was very calm.

However, Zhang Wenbo could easily tell how much Lin Fan hated Wang Xiu.

Zhang Wenbo glanced at Wang Xiu coldly and said with a muffled snort, “I’ve never seen such a cold-blooded woman! These days, she’s been showing off her strength in hopes of establishing a cooperative relationship with our Xiao Wu Wholesale City.

“I didn’t expect that her strength actually came from this!

“I was almost fooled by her.

“Our Xiao Wu Wholesale City will never establish a cooperative relationship with such a person!”

Wang Xiuyan’s face paled.

In order to cooperate with Xiao Wu Wholesale City, she rented a shop and prepared a lot of things.

If they could not cooperate, they would definitely suffer heavy losses.

“Manager Zhang, didn’t we already come to an agreement? You can’t break your promise!” Wang Xiu shouted.

If Lin Fan mistakenly thought that he had a good relationship with Wang Xiu, then…

“An agreement?” Zhang Wenbo shouted sternly. “That was because you were too good at lying!”

After saying that, he could not help but glance at Lin Fan.

At this moment, Wang Xiu also reacted. Everything was because of Mr. Lin.

Hence, she quickly bent down and begged, “Lil Zhong, can you help me beg Mr. Lin? I’m your aunt.”

Ma Zhong, who had always looked like a good person, said coldly, “Aunt? What aunt? Our family has nothing to do with you anymore!”

Wang Xiu looked at Ma Zhong’s cold expression. She understood that it was useless for her to beg him again.

Thus, Wang Xiu turned to Ma Dajiang and Liu Juan and said, “Brother, Sister-in-law, you also know that I have a big mouth. I was just talking nonsense a few days ago. Let Lil Zhong help say a few words.”
